}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "AGP00B-1.6" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. *OEM: [[SerComm]] • US ID: 5NHDL01BDGND4000 The default SSID patterns are likely '''NETGEARXX''' (2.4GHz) :and '''NETGEARXX-5G''' (5GHz), where '''XX''' is a ''randomly'' generated number. Possible 4C:60:DE OUI (in '''NETGEAR''''s manual)
===Specifications=== Per the FCC photos, this device is using... *[[Broadcom]] BCM6361UKFEBG 2.4GHz WiSoC *[[Broadcom]] BCM4331KMLG 5GHz Radio :3x [[Skyworks]] (''[[SiGe]]'') [http://www.skyworksinc.com/Product.aspx?ProductID=970 SE5004L/5004L] 5GHz PA ICs *[[Nanya]] NT5TU64M16DG-AC (probably) RAM chip
